## Added

- The group now shares its food level. When a player eats or gets hungry, the change applies to everyone. Saturation stays individual on purpose, so food drains faster than in solo play.
- `/sharedgroup configuration` opens a menu to turn health, food and potions synchronization on or off. Only OPs who own the group can open it, and only outside a game.

## Changed

- Food and saturation are reset to full when a game starts, and food is reset to full after a group death.

## Fixed

- `/sharedgroup remove` no longer risks an error when the group has no owner.
